function.name: exec
function.description: Run a bounded Bash command in the project sandbox. A relative cwd resolves against the project checkout. Each command has its own process namespace, so background processes stop when it returns.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a bounded slice of a UTF-8 text file. Relative paths resolve against the project checkout. Binary files are rejected; use exec to inspect their metadata or compute a text summary.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write or append UTF-8 text to a file. Relative paths resolve against the project checkout, and missing parent directories are created.
